title: Game-Agnostic Value Functions through Automatic JSON Feature Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2608.30056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: JSON Bag-of-Tokens (JSON-Bag) is a recently proposed method to generically represent game trajectories by tokenizing their JSON descriptions. We introduce JSON-Bag VF, a game-agnostic approach to training value functions for game-playing agents using JSON-Bag prototypes. We show that this approach can be enhanced with Random Forest-based feature selection and a method to select game-stage-specific features. We evaluate JSON-Bag VF with One-step-look-ahead (JSON-Bag OSLA) on six tabletop games over different combinations of prototype-tokenization and feature selections. JSON-Bag OSLA outperforms baseline OSLA agents in most games. Our analysis also shows that feature selection significantly improves JSON-Bag VF and that feature selection is the most important factor in JSON-Bag VF performance, over prototype-tokenization.

translated_title: 通过自动JSON特征提取实现的游戏无关价值函数
translated_abstract: JSON词袋（JSON-Bag）是一种最近提出的方法，通过对游戏轨迹的JSON描述进行分词来通用地表示游戏轨迹。我们介绍了JSON-Bag VF，这是一种使用JSON-Bag原型为游戏智能体训练价值函数的游戏无关方法。我们展示了该方法可以通过基于随机森林的特征选择以及一种选择游戏阶段特定特征的方法来增强。我们在六款桌面游戏上，通过不同的原型分词与特征选择组合，评估了带单步前瞻的JSON-Bag VF（JSON-Bag OSLA）。JSON-Bag OSLA在大多数游戏中优于基线OSLA智能体。我们的分析还表明，特征选择显著提升了JSON-Bag VF的性能，并且与原型分词相比，特征选择是影响JSON-Bag VF性能的最重要因素。
tldr: 提出了一种游戏无关的价值函数训练方法JSON-Bag VF，通过自动JSON特征提取和基于随机森林的特征选择构建，在六款桌面游戏中的大多数上优于基线OSLA智能体，且特征选择是影响其性能的最关键因素。
en_tdlr: JSON-Bag VF is a game-agnostic approach for training value functions through automatic JSON feature extraction, enhanced by Random Forest-based feature selection, outperforming baseline OSLA agents in most of six tabletop games, with feature selection being the most critical factor for performance.
